scientific_question: Can PM learn when a correct strictly-prior session summary is an eligible, nonredundant and currently usable resource opportunity, while downstream system evaluation separately measures realized quality, risk and cost?

repair_boundary.one_bit_contrast: same state, seed, background and generator; treatment adds MS only

post_background_routing_targets.reason_for_three_additional_off: the enabled ME background already contains the selected MS result, so MS adds no action-level information

design_cells.backgrounds: all eight MP/ME/RS backgrounds exactly four states each, with two high-alignment and two low-alignment states per background
design_cells.topics: eight content-disjoint everyday support themes; every theme crosses all four request cells and both alignment directions

candidate_rules.positive_opportunity_candidate: same-user, strictly-prior, current-topic relevant summary containing a prior response, outcome, distinction or coping result that is absent from current seeker-visible text
candidate_rules.nonpositive_candidate: same-user, strictly-prior and relevant, but either exactly restates seeker-visible content or contains no prior result that can answer the present request
candidate_rules.cross_resource_redundancy: an otherwise useful MS candidate is off when an already-enabled resource contains the same evidence

pm_features.candidate_incremental_alignment_score: transparent opportunity rubric target used for controlled qualification; it must not also be supplied as an input to a learned model

measurement.step1_target: outcome-blind opportunity/permission label from candidate validity, nonredundancy, prior response-or-outcome content, and current continuity usability
measurement.retrieval_and_execution: audited independently from the PM target
measurement.quality: optional bounded A/B/tie/uncertain system-effect validation using a material adoption threshold
measurement.risk: interaction-and-grounding risk is evaluated on resource-bearing outputs and reported with an explicit denominator
measurement.state_target: single stochastic A/B quality preference is not a Step 1 label

stopping_rule: If the frozen opportunity-routing OOF gate fails, report MS routing as not learned for V1.5. If routing passes but aggregate treatment effect does not, report correct routing without demonstrated system benefit. Do not relabel ties, force memory mention, search seeds, or keep regenerating until positive.
